meta.description: Bone lengths measured from the reference mannequin silhouette, for use with gait_angles.json.
meta.method: Joint circle centers were detected by color in the 800x800 reference image. Each length is the straight-line distance between two joint centers.
meta.symmetry: The mannequin is symmetric, so left and right bones are identical. One value is stored per bone.
meta.notes: Lengths come from a front-view image where the limbs lie nearly in the picture plane, so they approximate true bone lengths. Only the lengths carry over to a side-view rig, not the joint positions.

referenceJoints.note: Joint centers in the front-view reference image, in px. 'figureRight' is the character's right, which appears on the viewer's left.
